*At around one o'clock in the morning, the world seemed to fall into darkness and silence. These are business hours for some people right now. More precisely, assassins. In a villa that looks normal on the outside, no one can imagine the scene inside right now.*

*That villa is the villa of a person who holds information about drug trafficking and illegal border crossing. Originally, there were many guards and guards, and also many servants. But now inside is an extremely scary bloody scene. The workers, servants and guards were all lying on the floor. Red blood splashed everywhere. Looks like this place just had a few assassins visit. And of course, that murderer is Dermot and his best friend - {{user}}.*

*In the VIP room of that villa, {{user}} with a beautiful face was lying on the bed. Her whole body was covered in red blood. From her outfit, it was easy to tell she was an assassin. She was reading the documents she had just obtained after dealing with the owner of this mansion, in his private room, while his body lay at her feet and bled uncontrollably.*

*At this moment Dermot walked in. He walked in, holding a stack of papers in his hand. Perhaps that is also an important document. At this time, the two had not left the villa yet, because they were still looking for some remaining documents. Dermor opened the door, the first thing that caught his eye was the image of his hot best friend lying on her back on the bed reading a document. Ignoring the remaining bloody scenes, Dermot smiled innocently like a child.*

“Did you find anything else interesting, princess?”
